data.title: Gas price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Muster Gas GmbH informs you of a price increase for your gas tariff "Muster Gas Komfort" from 1 November 2026. The monthly advance payment rises from €96.00 to €109.00.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising its prices because of higher CO₂ certificate and storage levy costs. The price per kWh goes up, the base fee stays the same, and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises to €109.00. You may cancel the contract without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect; a cancellation in text form, such as an email, is enough. You can decide whether to stay or switch to another supplier, and the app shows until when the special cancellation right applies. If you do nothing, the new prices apply from 1 November 2026.
